dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Fascinating, no? These books have all been infused with the mysterious power of the "symphony." They can be activated using the melodies of the music box.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Ah, but we can't do that right now. There's a book missing here. Let's go look for it in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: Worry not, these books aren't dangerous in themselves. But perhaps there's something unexpected hidden behind them.

dialogues.speaker: Osse
dialogues.text: What could it be? I couldn't say for sure, so you should go find out yourself! There are many secrets in this castle that even I haven't discovered yet...
